name: Feature

## Problem

The need or limitation that motivates this feature.

## Expected behavior

How things should work once this is built.

## Acceptance criteria

Checks that must pass for this to be considered done.

## Scope

What this issue covers.

## Out of scope

What this issue deliberately leaves out.

## Investigation notes

Findings so far: prior art, relevant files, approaches already considered.
